text: 39 Diwali 2. Listen and read. It is Diwali. Ayan got up early in the morning. He took ‘Abhyangsnan’ with ‘Utane’. He wore new clothes. After praying, he touched the feet of his elders and took their blessings. All the family members had the ‘faral’ together. In the evening, Ayan helped his sister to light the lamps. His sister lit the paper lantern. They helped mother to make the ‘rangoli’. Ayan’s friends visited his house. Everyone wished each other ‘Shubh Deepawali’. They enjoyed the ‘faral’ and had a wonderful time together.
